_comment: Owner-editable casting sheet for Zone 1 (k26_30). voice_id per speaker x locale is used by --audition; leave it null to skip that line. Values here are never generated automatically and never overwrite canonical dialogue.
casting_status_note: Owner named final choices for all 8 role x locale slots after AUDITION SET B (zh-TW Elder: Christopher, zh-TW Hero: Roy - Taiwanese Youth, en Hero: Anvay - Calm & Reassuring). The 5 slots already resolved to a real voice_id in this repo are LOCKED. The 3 new picks were discovered live by --audition-set-b running on the Owner's local machine and recorded only in the Owner's local casting_candidates.json (never pushed back here) -- this repo copy does not have their real voice_id values yet, so those 3 slots stay locked:false/voice_id:null until the Owner sends them (upload the local casting_candidates.json, or the 3 voice_id strings). --generate-tts fails closed and refuses to run until all 8 are locked.
locking_policy: Once a role x locale slot has "locked": true, no automated tool in this directory (including --audition-set-b) may overwrite its voice_id or candidates without the Owner explicitly unlocking it first. This is enforced in code by cmd_audition_set_b(), not just by convention.

pending_roles.reason: Owner approved Christopher (AUDITION SET B, Voice Library) as final zh-TW Elder, but this repo does not yet have the real voice_id -- awaiting handoff.
